capabilities: Insert word, character, reading-time, image, and block counts into a note's first or last three lines
Write computed values into frontmatter fields with leave/write/delete/clear policies
Insert edit marks, author name, custom text, images, and fixed link/image slots
Generate an SVG mind map of the article outline in horizontal, vertical, or radial layouts
Replace the previous insertion in place on update so nothing is duplicated
disambiguation: It writes its own computed values into Frontmatter; it does not read or display your existing properties.
extras: Desktop only (uses Node crypto and fs for image MD5 de-duplication); no automatic refresh — updating is always an explicit action; bilingual Chinese/English UI; full Chinese walkthrough kept in docs/ rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no one-click way to insert and keep updated document statistics, edit marks, or an outline diagram inside a note's body or frontmatter.

relations.evidence: This lets tools that read Frontmatter — the built-in Bases, Dataview, and similar — query the numbers
an optional Pandoc filter pack shipped in optional/word-export/

summary: Inserts auto-counted statistics, edit marks, custom content, and an outline mind map at the head or tail of a note, refreshed on demand.
